Research protocol / 01

Method

Read water as a spatial, civic and financial system.

This atlas records how the Netherlands makes water visible across three scales: territorial defence, urban infrastructure and everyday inhabitation.

  1. 01Observe

    Document the physical system, public interface and operational logic on site.

  2. 02Separate

    Keep verified context, field reading and research interpretation distinct.

  3. 03Connect

    Trace how design decisions move between governance, development and daily life.

Cyan symbols identify visited sites. Amber symbols identify suggested locations that were not visited on this trip. Their readings are desk research, not field observations. Each expanded visited record identifies its evidence basis: recorded experience, paraphrased conversation, or spatial interpretation. Takeaways are research interpretations; open questions identify evidence still needed. A visit does not establish measured performance or represent every user's experience. Representative photographs are credited source images, not Hao's field photographs unless explicitly identified. Published drawings retain their original credits and link to their source. The public atlas does not contain raw interview transcripts or private correspondence.
